title: Prometheus
subtitle: A pull-based metrics system with a time-series store and alerting.

tiles.label: Scrape (pull)
tiles.says: Prometheus pulls metrics over HTTP on a schedule.
tiles.detail: Pull makes target health visible: if a scrape fails, the up metric says so.

tiles.label: Exporters
tiles.says: Exporters translate system metrics into the text format.
tiles.detail: node_exporter and others cover hosts, databases and hardware without changing the source.

tiles.label: Service discovery
tiles.says: Targets are discovered from Kubernetes, DNS or files.
tiles.detail: ServiceMonitors keep scrape config in step with deployments, so new services are monitored automatically.

tiles.label: TSDB
tiles.says: The TSDB writes samples to a WAL and compacted blocks.
tiles.detail: Efficient local storage with configurable retention keeps queries fast and operations simple.

tiles.label: PromQL
tiles.says: PromQL slices, aggregates and rates time series.
tiles.detail: Labels turn metrics into dimensions, enabling service level indicators like request rate and p95 latency.

tiles.label: Long-term storage
tiles.says: Sidecars and remote write extend retention.
tiles.detail: Blocks in object storage allow global queries and historical capacity planning.

tiles.label: Recording rules
tiles.detail: Dashboards load quickly and SLO calculations stay consistent.

tiles.label: Alerting rules
tiles.says: Alert rules fire when conditions hold for a duration.
tiles.detail: The for clause cuts flapping, so people are paged only for sustained problems.

tiles.label: Alertmanager
tiles.says: Alertmanager groups, silences and routes notifications.
tiles.detail: Deduplication and routing trees send the right alert to the right team once.

declarations: Labels are dimensions, so keep cardinality low.
